title: Dada Ji's Talking Doggo
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

Riya.look: young woman, graceful, fair skin, long wavy dark-brown hair tied in a loose bun, small silver hoop earrings, wearing a pastel yellow cotton kurta with white embroidery and straight pants. Expressive brown eyes.

Dada Ji.look: elderly man, kind wrinkled face, white mustache, spectacles perched on his nose, balding with white hair on sides, wearing a traditional light blue checked shirt and white dhoti. Always has a gentle smile.

Chintu.look: fluffy white Pomeranian dog, small, with big curious black eyes and a bright red collar. His tail wags constantly.

scenes.image: [[Riya]] peeking from behind a doorframe, wide-eyed and shocked expression. [[Dada Ji]] is animatedly talking to [[Chintu]] who sits on his lap, looking engaged. Bright sunlight through a window.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Yeh pakka dog hai ya philosopher?
scenes.say: ये पक्का डॉग है या फिलॉसफर?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Dada Ji]] smiling warmly at [[Chintu]], who is gazing intently at Dada Ji, head slightly tilted. Both look very comfortable together.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dada Ji aur Chintu ki jodi best thi.
scenes.say: दादा जी और चिंटू की जोड़ी बेस्ट थी।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] smiles lovingly as she hugs [[Dada Ji]] in his living room. [[Chintu]] is playfully tugging at Riya's kurta string.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Riya apne Dada Ji se milne roz aati thi.
scenes.say: रिया अपने दादा जी से मिलने रोज़ आती थी।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] offering [[Chintu]] a biscuit from a plate. Chintu eagerly takes it. Riya watches, amused.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Chintu unka pyaara companion tha, ekdum shararti.
scenes.say: चिंटू उनका प्यारा कंपैनियन था, एकदम शरारती।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] laughs, covering her mouth, as [[Dada Ji]] tells a funny story. [[Chintu]] is asleep at Dada Ji's feet.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dada Ji thode eccentric the, par sabse pyaare.
scenes.say: दादा जी थोड़े एक्सेंट्रिक थे, पर सबसे प्यारे।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] gestures with his hand, looking serious. [[Chintu]] is on his lap, nodding subtly.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Chintu bol raha tha, aaj ghar mein khichdi banegi.
scenes.say: चिंटू बोल रहा था, आज घर में खिचड़ी बनेगी।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] stands beside them, a confused smile on her face, scratching her head.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Dada Ji, aap mazaak kar rahe ho na?
scenes.say: दादा जी, आप मज़ाक कर रहे हो ना?

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] looks at [[Riya]] with a knowing smile, gently stroking [[Chintu]].
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Arey, woh sach mein baat karta hai, Riya.
scenes.say: अरे, वो सच में बात करता है, रिया।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Chintu]] looking innocent, head tilted, with a questioning look in his eyes.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Woof! (main toh chup hi tha).
scenes.say: वूफ! (मैं तो चुप ही था)।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] looks skeptical, hands on her hips, watching [[Dada Ji]] and [[Chintu]].
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Mujhe toh kuch sunai nahi deta, Dada Ji.
scenes.say: मुझे तो कुछ सुनाई नहीं देता, दादा जी।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] shrugs playfully, making a funny face at [[Riya]].
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Uski special language hai, sirf main samjhta hoon.
scenes.say: उसकी स्पेशल लैंग्वेज है, सिर्फ मैं समझता हूं।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] kneels down, trying to coax [[Chintu]] to speak, holding a treat. Chintu looks away dismissively.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Chintu, batao toh, tum baat karte ho kya?
scenes.say: चिंटू, बताओ तो, तुम बात करते हो क्या?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Chintu]] yawning widely, showing no interest in Riya's question.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Yawn... boring baatein nahi karta main.
scenes.say: यॉन... बोरिंग बातें नहीं करता मैं।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] looks disappointed, standing up. [[Dada Ji]] chuckles softly.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Dekho, Dada Ji! Chintu toh kuch nahi bol raha.
scenes.say: देखो, दादा जी! चिंटू तो कुछ नहीं बोल रहा।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] pats [[Chintu]]'s head. Chintu wags his tail at Dada Ji.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Woh sirf mujhse comfort feel karta hai.
scenes.say: वो सिर्फ मुझसे कंफर्ट फील करता है।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] searching frantically for her keys on a table, looking stressed.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Meri chaabiyan kahaan gayin? Oh no!
scenes.say: मेरी चाबियां कहां गईं? ओह नो!

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] points towards a flower pot with a gentle smile. [[Chintu]] is sitting by the pot.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Chintu bol raha hai, flower pot ke neeche dekho.
scenes.say: चिंटू बोल रहा है, फ्लावर पॉट के नीचे देखो।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] looks at the flower pot, then at Dada Ji, surprised. She slowly picks up the pot.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Flower pot ke neeche? Pakka?
scenes.say: फ्लावर पॉट के नीचे? पक्का?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Riya]]'s hand discovering her keys under the pot, expression of shock.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Meri chaabiyan! Yeh kaise pata chala?
scenes.say: मेरी चाबियां! ये कैसे पता चला?

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] winks at [[Riya]], a playful glint in his eyes. [[Chintu]] gives a smug look.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Chintu toh sab jaanta hai, meri bacchi.
scenes.say: चिंटू तो सब जानता है, मेरी बच्ची।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] now looks thoughtful and a bit suspicious, observing [[Dada Ji]] and [[Chintu]] from a distance.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Yeh coincidence nahi ho sakta hai.
scenes.say: ये कोइंसिडेंस नहीं हो सकता है।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] and [[Chintu]] are sitting on the couch, Dada Ji reading a newspaper, Chintu alert.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Chintu bol raha hai, Riya ko samosa chahiye.
scenes.say: चिंटू बोल रहा है, रिया को समोसा चाहिए।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] in the kitchen, about to pick up a samosa she had just bought, freezes, eyes wide.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: What? Main toh abhi soch rahi thi!
scenes.say: व्हाट? मैं तो अभी सोच रही थी!

scenes.image: [[Riya]] paces back and forth, looking genuinely worried. Her hands are pressed to her temples.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Dada Ji ko doctor ki zaroorat hai, shayad.
scenes.say: दादा जी को डॉक्टर की ज़रूरत है, शायद।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] looks slightly hurt, turning his head away from [[Riya]]. [[Chintu]] whines softly.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Tumhe mujhpar bharosa nahi hai?
scenes.say: तुम्हें मुझपर भरोसा नहीं है?

scenes.image: [[Riya]] sighs, feeling guilty but still confused. She looks at the ceiling, thinking.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Mujhe iska solution dhundhna padega.
scenes.say: मुझे इसका सलूशन ढूँढना पड़ेगा।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] secretly unpacking small, discreet camera boxes. A determined look on her face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Riya ne ek plan banaya.
scenes.say: रिया ने एक प्लान बनाया।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] carefully placing a miniature camera behind a potted plant in the living room.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Ab pata chalega asliyat.
scenes.say: अब पता चलेगा असलियत।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] setting up another tiny camera on a bookshelf, blending it with books. Intense focus.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne ghar mein hidden cameras laga diye.
scenes.say: उसने घर में हिडन कैमरा लगा दिए।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] is offering a piece of apple to [[Chintu]]. Dada Ji is smiling, talking.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Kaisa laga Chintu? Tasty hai na?
scenes.say: कैसा लगा चिंटू? टेस्टी है ना?

scenes.image: [[Chintu]] takes the apple piece, looks up at Dada Ji, seeming to reply with subtle movements.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Bohat accha hai, Dada Ji! Thank you!
scenes.say: बहुत अच्छा है, दादा जी! थैंक यू!

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] laughs heartily, patting [[Chintu]]'s head. Chintu wags his tail vigorously.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Tum kitne cute ho, Chintu!
scenes.say: तुम कितने क्यूट हो, चिंटू!

scenes.image: Later, [[Riya]] is hunched over her laptop, reviewing the camera footage, a serious expression.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Riya ne footage check karna shuru kiya.
scenes.say: रिया ने फुटेज चेक करना शुरू किया।

scenes.image: Close-up of the laptop screen, showing [[Dada Ji]] talking and reacting, but [[Chintu]] sitting silently.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dada Ji toh poori baat kar rahe the.
scenes.say: दादा जी तो पूरी बात कर रहे थे।

scenes.image: Close-up of the laptop screen, [[Chintu]] on screen, mouth closed, silent. Riya's hand points at the screen, bewildered.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Par Chintu... Chintu toh chup hai!
scenes.say: पर चिंटू... चिंटू तो चुप है!

scenes.image: [[Riya]] rewinds the video, playing it again, her eyes wide with disbelief. She pinches herself.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Kya meri aankhon ko dhokha ho raha hai?
scenes.say: क्या मेरी आँखों को धोखा हो रहा है?

scenes.image: [[Riya]] furiously clicking through different camera angles on her laptop. All show the same thing.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne har angle se dekha, par results same.
scenes.say: उसने हर एंगल से देखा, पर रिजल्ट्स सेम।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] frustrated, pulling her hair gently, looking up at the ceiling in despair.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Dada Ji toh bilkul normal dikh rahe hain.
scenes.say: दादा जी तो बिलकुल नॉर्मल दिख रहे हैं।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Dada Ji]] on screen, laughing at something Chintu 'said'. His reaction is genuine.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unka reaction real tha, pura believe kar rahe the.
scenes.say: उनका रिएक्शन रियल था, पूरा बिलीव कर रहे थे।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] holding her head in her hands, utterly confused. She looks like she's about to cry.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Toh kya woh sach mein...
scenes.say: तो क्या वो सच में...

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] is watering plants in the garden, humming. [[Chintu]] is sniffing around a rose bush.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Agle din, Riya ne Dada Ji ko confront kiya.
scenes.say: अगले दिन, रिया ने दादा जी को कंफ्रंट किया।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] holds up her laptop, showing the video to [[Dada Ji]]. Dada Ji looks at the screen, then at Riya.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Dada Ji, yeh dekho video. Chintu toh chup hai.
scenes.say: दादा जी, ये देखो वीडियो। चिंटू तो चुप है।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] takes off his spectacles, sighs sadly, looking at [[Chintu]].
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Main janta tha tum yeh karogi, Riya.
scenes.say: मैं जनता था तुम ये करोगी, रिया।

scenes.image: [[Chintu]] looks up at [[Dada Ji]] with a concerned expression, then glances at Riya disapprovingly.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Isne cameras lagaye? Dada Ji, yeh toh galat hai.
scenes.say: इसने कैमरा लगाए? दादा जी, ये तो गलत है।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] puts a hand on [[Chintu]]'s head, a reassuring smile. [[Riya]] looks utterly baffled.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Chintu, use sunai nahi deta, ya samajh nahi aata.
scenes.say: चिंटू, उसे सुनाई नहीं देता, या समझ नहीं आता।

scenes.image: [[Riya]]'s jaw drops. Her eyes are wide as she stares between Dada Ji and Chintu.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Wait! Aap abhi bhi usse baat kar rahe ho?
scenes.say: वेट! आप अभी भी उससे बात कर रहे हो?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Chintu]] looking directly at Dada Ji, mouth closed, yet an expression of speaking.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Riya ko toh pakka nahi sunega.
scenes.say: रिया को तो पक्का नहीं सुनेगा।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] smiles at [[Riya]], a hint of mischief. He translates for Chintu.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Woh keh raha hai, tumhein sunai nahi dega.
scenes.say: वो कह रहा है, तुम्हें सुनाई नहीं देगा।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] throws her hands up in exasperation, but a tiny hint of wonder appears in her eyes.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Toh sach mein woh baat karta hai?
scenes.say: तो सच में वो बात करता है?

scenes.image: [[Chintu]] huffs, looking annoyed at Riya, then lovingly at Dada Ji.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Dada Ji hi hain jo mujhe sunte hain.
scenes.say: दादा जी ही हैं जो मुझे सुनते हैं।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] looks at [[Riya]], then back at [[Chintu]], sharing a secret smile.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Usko recording pasand nahi aati.
scenes.say: उसको रिकॉर्डिंग पसंद नहीं आती।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Riya]]'s face, her confusion slowly turning into grudging acceptance and a little smile.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Isliye woh videos mein chup rehta hai?
scenes.say: इसलिए वो वीडियो में चुप रहता है?

scenes.image: [[Chintu]] nods at Dada Ji, then gives Riya a sassy side-eye.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Aur mujhe Riya ke questions bhi boring lagte hain.
scenes.say: और मुझे रिया के क्वेश्चंस भी बोरिंग लगते हैं।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] laughs out loud, covering his mouth. [[Riya]] gasps, a playful angry expression.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Chintu keh raha hai, tumhare questions boring hain.
scenes.say: चिंटू कह रहा है, तुम्हारे क्वेश्चंस बोरिंग हैं।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] makes a face at [[Chintu]], who sticks his tongue out playfully at her.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Hey! Tum kitne mean ho, Chintu!
scenes.say: हे! तुम कितने मीन हो, चिंटू!

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] gently pats [[Chintu]], who rests his head on Dada Ji's lap, looking content.
scenes.speaker: Dada Ji
scenes.line: Ab toh maan gayi na, meri bacchi?
scenes.say: अब तो मान गई ना, मेरी बच्ची?

scenes.image: [[Riya]] shrugs, a defeated but amused smile on her face. She looks at Dada Ji with affection.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Kya kar sakte hain, Dada Ji.
scenes.say: क्या कर सकते हैं, दादा जी।

scenes.image: [[Chintu]] wags his tail happily, looking at Dada Ji. Dada Ji smiles warmly at him.
scenes.speaker: Chintu
scenes.line: Mera secret sirf Dada Ji ke liye hai.
scenes.say: मेरा सीक्रेट सिर्फ दादा जी के लिए है।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] sighs, then smiles, accepting the quirky reality. She shakes her head playfully.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Yeh duniya bhi kitni ajeeb hai.
scenes.say: यह दुनिया भी कितनी अजीब है।

scenes.image: [[Dada Ji]] and [[Chintu]] share a loving, knowing look. Riya watches them, smiling.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur Chintu ka raaz, unka raaz hi raha.
scenes.say: और चिंटू का राज़, उनका राज़ ही रहा।

scenes.image: [[Riya]] smiles and shrugs at the camera, then points to herself with a question mark expression.
scenes.speaker: Riya
scenes.line: Would you believe your grandpa?
scenes.say: वुड यू बिलीव योर ग्रैंडपा?

caption: My Grandpa's Dog Only Talks To Him... And Nobody Believes Me 🐶
yt_title: My Grandpa's Dog Only Talks To Him... And Nobody Believes Me 🐶
description:
My grandpa's dog, Chintu, claims to talk, but only to my grandpa!
I tried everything to prove it, but the twist left me speechless.
Have you ever had a pet with a secret talent?
